final: WITH grouped AS (SELECT p.fundflux, AVG(s.boxy / s.boxz) AS yz_avg, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), count_average AS (SELECT AVG(record_count) AS avg_count FROM grouped) SELECT AVG(g.yz_avg) AS avg_yz_avg, SUM(g.record_count) AS total_count, AVG(g.record_count - a.avg_count) AS avg_count_difference FROM grouped AS g JOIN count_average AS a ON a.avg_count IS NOT NULL AND g.record_count > a.avg_count
